definitions.gloss: local area; localized spot; specific part
definitions.explanation: A limited, specific area or part of a larger whole. Frequently used in medical and technical contexts to describe something affecting only a particular area rather than the whole.

examples.japanese: {局所|きょくしょ}{麻酔|ますい}で{手術|しゅじゅつ}を{行|おこな}う。
examples.english: To perform surgery under local anesthesia.

examples.japanese: {局所的|きょくしょてき}な{大雨|おおあめ}に{注意|ちゅうい}してください。
examples.english: Please be cautious of localized heavy rain.

examples.japanese: {炎症|えんしょう}は{局所|きょくしょ}にとどまっており、{全身|ぜんしん}には{広|ひろ}がっていない。
examples.english: The inflammation is confined to a local area and has not spread throughout the body.

notes: Often used as a modifier with {的|てき}: {局所的|きょくしょてき} (localized). Common collocations: {局所|きょくしょ}{麻酔|ますい} (local anesthesia), {局所的|きょくしょてき}な{大雨|おおあめ} (localized heavy rain), {局所|きょくしょ}{治療|ちりょう} (local treatment). Contrasts with {全身|ぜんしん} (whole body) and {全体|ぜんたい} (whole/overall). In weather forecasts, {局所的|きょくしょてき}な{大雨|おおあめ} (commonly called ゲリラ{豪雨|ごうう}) is a frequently heard expression.
